description: Rate limiter adds delay between requests to the same domain

docs.title: Rate limiter adds delay between requests to the same domain

skip.reason: min_duration_ms is wall-clock elapsed time for the whole crawl() call, not a response field. Neither CrawlResult nor CrawlPageResult nor ResponseMeta carries per-request or per-crawl timing (verified against crates/crawlberg/src/types/results.rs and types/metadata.rs), and the crawl call's result_fields allowlist in alef.toml has no timing entry. The rate-limit delay itself is exercised by pages_crawled == 3 above; the elapsed-time assertion would need harness-level wall-clock measurement outside the response, which alef's e2e generator does not support.
